launchCore: server-authoritative free-flight spaceship movement with boost energy
three connected space sectors with visible warp gates
asteroid mining with finite cargo capacity and respawn
central station docking, ore selling, repair and upgrades
hostile pirate drones with sector-scaled combat pressure
persistent credits, ore, ship tier, laser level and sector
mobile-first movement, mining, combat and station controls
shared-world multiplayer ships and server-owned rewards
gameDescriptionKo: 작은 개척선을 몰아 운석을 채굴하고, 해적 드론과 싸우고, 정거장에서 장비를 강화해 더 위험한 성역으로 워프하는 우주 탐험 게임.
gameDescriptionEn: Pilot a frontier ship, mine asteroids, fight pirate drones, upgrade at stations, and warp into increasingly dangerous sectors.
